dias.definition: n. Portuguese explorer who in 1488 was the first European to get round the Cape of Good Hope (thus establishing a sea route from the Atlantic to Asia) (1450-1500)
dias.translation: n. 二叠纪；迪亚斯（品牌）

diaschistic.translation: [医] 神经机能联系不能的; 双染色体分离的

diascopy.translation: [医] 玻片压诊法; 透照法

diasone.translation: n. [药]大艾松,狄阿宗,亚磺氨苯砜钠(抗麻风药)[商标名]

diaspididae.translation:
n. 盾蚧科
[网络] 盾介壳虫科；盾价科；盾蚜科

diaspirin.translation: 琥珀酰水杨酸, 双阿司匹灵

diaspora.definition:
n. the body of Jews (or Jewish communities) outside Palestine or modern Israel
n. the dispersion of the Jews outside Israel; from the destruction of the temple in Jerusalem in 587-86 BC when they were exiled to Babylonia up to the present time
n. the dispersion or spreading of something that was originally localized (as a people or language or culture)
diaspora.translation: n. 犹太人的离散, 离散的犹太人

diasporas.definition:
plural of Diaspora
n. the body of Jews (or Jewish communities) outside Palestine or modern Israel
n. the dispersion of the Jews outside Israel; from the destruction of the temple in Jerusalem in 587-86 BC when they were exiled to Babylonia up to the present time
n. the dispersion or spreading of something that was originally localized (as a people or language or culture)
diasporas.translation: (Diaspora 的复数) n. 犹太人的离散, 离散的犹太人

diaspore.definition:
n. A hydrate of alumina, often occurring in white lamellar
   masses with brilliant pearly luster; -- so named on account of its
   decrepitating when heated before the blowpipe.

diastalsis.translation: n. (小肠的)间波蠕动, 波状蠕动

diastase.definition:
n. A soluble, nitrogenous ferment, capable of converting
   starch and dextrin into sugar.
diastase.translation:
n. 淀粉酶, 酶
[化] 淀粉酶; 淀粉糖化酶

diastase butter.translation: [医] 淀粉酶试验(检肾机能)

diastasemia.translation: 红细胞分解, 红血球分解

diastasic.definition:
a. Pertaining to, or consisting of, diastase; as, diastasic
   ferment.

diastasic action.translation:
[化] 淀粉糖化作用
[医] 淀粉消化作用

diastasimetry.translation: 淀粉酶测定法, 糖化力测定

diastasis.definition: n separation of an epiphysis from the long bone to which it is normally attached without fracture of the bone

diastatic.definition:
a. Relating to diastase; having the properties of diastase;
   effecting the conversion of starch into sugar.
diastatic.translation: a. [生化]淀粉酵素的, 脱离的

diastem.definition:
n. Intervening space; interval.
n. An interval.

diastema.definition: n a gap or vacant space between two teeth

diaster.definition:
n. A double star; -- applied to the nucleus of a cell, when,
   during cell division, the loops of the nuclear network separate into
   two groups, preparatory to the formation of two daughter nuclei. See
   Karyokinesis.
diaster.translation: n. (=anaphase)[生](有丝分裂的)双星期,双星体

diastereoisomerism.translation:
[化] 非对映异构现象
[医] 非对映异构

diastereotopic ligand.translation: [机] 非镜像立体异构向性配基

diastole.definition: n. the widening of the chambers of the heart between two contractions when the chambers fill with blood
diastole.translation:
n. 心脏舒张, 心脏舒张期, 延长音节
[医] 舒张

diastolic.definition: a. of or relating to a diastole or happening during a diastole
diastolic.translation:
a. 心脏舒张的
[医] 舒张的

diastral.translation: a. [生](有丝分裂的)双星期的, 双星体的

diastrophic.translation: [医]弯曲变形的：弯的或弯曲的, 指某些结构如骨骼以这种方式变形的

diastrophism.definition: n. the process of deformation that produces continents and ocean basins in the earth's crust
diastrophism.translation: n. 地壳运动, 地壳运动形成的地层

diastyle.translation: a. 柱间距离等于柱径三倍的,长距列柱式的
